name: Two-Fanged Pounce
body:
Two-Fanged Pounce
Source Villain Codex pg. 176
If the barbarian is wielding a pair of daggers, kukris, or punching daggers, she can attack once with each of the two weapons when she charges. If she does, she loses the bonus on attack rolls for charging and takes an additional –2 penalty to her AC, and she applies precision damage or effects that occur on a hit only once, even if she hits with both attacks.
